items.title: Derivation of Expression for Energy Stored in a Stretched Material (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Derivation of Expression for Energy Stored in a Stretched Material: a main subheading of 5.6 Strain energy in deformed materials, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 99-99.

blocks.text: Spring ki shakal ka ek material lein (Fig. 5.6). Force F use x (yani Δx) extension tak kheenchti hai. Elastic limit ke andar extension force ke seedha proportional hai, is liye force zero se F tak uniformly (ek jaisi rate se) barhti hai (Fig. 5.7). Is liye spring ko Δx tak kheenchne wali average force ½F hai. Kheenchne wali force ka kaam:

blocks.alt: Horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) support se do springs latakte hain. Baen spring apni asal lambai par hai (Original length of spring). Daen spring par slotted weights ka bojh hai aur woh lamba hai; do horizontal lines ke beech teer baen spring ke sire se neeche us ka extension x dikhate hain. Bojh ke saath teer F neeche ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Asal lambai ka spring force F se extension x tak khincha hua (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Kaam (work) = average force × force ki direction mein tay kiya faasla
Kheenchne wali force ka kaam spring mein strain energy ban kar jama hota hai, aur yeh us ke molecules mein jama potential energy ke barabar hai:

blocks.alt: Force F ka extension delta x ke muqable graph, origin O se. Seedhi line O se force F par P tak uthti hai; dashed line P ko F-axis se jorti hai aur dotted line P se extension axis par Q tak girti hai. Triangle OPQ grey rang mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Force F ka extension delta x ke muqable graph; rangeen triangle OPQ (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force zero se F tak seedhi line mein barhti hai, is liye average force F/2 hai. Triangle OPQ ka area = ½ × F × Δx, jo spring kheenchne mein kiya gaya kaam aur us mein jama energy hai.
